description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Object' class, which implements the XHTML 1.1 Object Module, adding elements and attributes related to 'object' tags for HTML sanitization. It sets up rules for the 'object' and 'param' HTML elements, specifying their attributes and behavior within the purification configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Object
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule to define elements and attributes related to the HTML 'object' element, according to XHTML 1.1 specifications.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the import of 'object' and 'param' elements, defining their content models, attributes, and properties within the HTML purification framework.
